attributes.title: 22nd Annual Professional School Counseling Conference
attributes.summary:
The Texas Counseling Association holds its 22nd Annual Professional School Counseling Conference from January 31 to February 2, 2027, at Kalahari Resorts & Conventions in Round Rock, just north of Austin. The 2027 theme is "Rise and Radiate," and the program combines keynotes with breakout sessions built for school counselors, from first-year staff to district leaders.

The conference brings together school counselors from districts across Texas for practical campus strategies, networking and time to recharge. TCA offers a customizable letter that attendees can share with a principal or district office to request approval to attend.

Early-bird registration costs $185 and is limited to TCA members, with an early-bird deadline of November 22, 2026; non-members see only the administrator rate online. Payment by card or by check with a PDF form is accepted, and refund requests are due by January 8, 2027. The conference page does not list the number of CE hours, so confirm credit details with TCA if you need them for an LPC or school counselor renewal.
